name: TerpWallet AI
tagline: Watches a student's spending and connects them to free campus resources like the food pantry and safe rides.
problem: Students pay for things the university already provides free.
solution: Analyses bank transactions via a mock banking API and recommends campus resources through an agent on the campus AI platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: a food purchase triggers a pantry suggestion.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TerpAI Ultimate Agent Showdown - Cloudforce/Microsoft” among 223 submissions.
Built solo around real campus services.

lessons: Local resources make an agent indispensable.
